ACadSharp 3.8.0 (MIT)
------------------------------------------------------------
No ACadSharp code ships with TOMLIN OS. CAD Draft's own DWG reader and writer
(src/apps/cad/dwg) follow the design of parts of ACadSharp: the 2007-format
decompression and page layout, and the plot settings a new layout is given.
ACadSharp was also used, offline, to check the files CAD Draft writes and to
make the test drawings in test/fixtures/dwg.
